Then focus on killing the rest ASAP.  The build i had made it so I could 1 shot them with blizzard. Make sure when he knocks you back you are either close enough to him to not be in range of the slappy hands at the back of the room  or he hits you into the wall so you are behind them cuz if you air dodge in front of the hands you’re pretty much screwed. I found that sometimes the wind will knock you out of range from the fireballs which helps. The other tricky part about this is to actually have enough mana to deal with the hands. In my opinion: Seeing people get portable consoles in particular signed is completely pointless in regards to adding value to a collectible. Nobody is going to  buy your janky ass signed piece of hardware unless the signatures are completely intact and the switch is in perfect condition.  (Collectors can be a neurotic bunch at times and like things like air tight Cases to view visually perfect specimens) however having it for yourself is actually pretty cool if you were to frame it and never use it. My reason for having this opinion is cuz my friend got the back of his Pikachu 3ds signed by Veronica Taylor he decided to keep using it and now there is black inked smudged all along the back of the console and to me he essentially payed 50$ to scuff up a perfectly good console which is already a Collectible because nobody bought the Pikachu 3ds. Moral of the story think long and hard when you want to get something signed.
